newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA- BIRZAI SAYS PROFIT UP IN JAN-FEB 97'.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA- BIRZAI SAYS PROFIT UP IN JAN-FEB 97'.

text.p: Lithuania's Birzai Dairy said on Thursday that its net profit in the first two months of 1997 doubled to 700,000 litas versus the same period in 1996.
"Our profit doubled to 700,000 litas in the first two months' of this year compared to the same period last year," Birzai's general director Vladas Songaila told Reuters by telephone.
He did not say exactly what the figure was for the first two months of last year.
The company's unaudited results for 1996 show a net profit of 1.9 million litas versus 3.8 million litas the year before.
Songaila told Reuters that the company's audited figures, due out next week, would show almost the same results as the unaudited statement.
The company is one of the leading blue chip shares on Lithuania's bourse.
